brief.meaningEn: The final or supposedly definitive statement about a subject.
brief.meaningZh: 對某議題被視為最終、具權威性的結論或說法。
brief.grammar: the last word on the matter; not the last word on a subject.
brief.register: Neutral set phrase, often used to caution against treating one source as final.
brief.boundaryZh: 表示「最終定論」，不必是字面最後說出的字；單一初步來源往往不足以作定論。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要因一篇短文或一個人的意見就假設問題已完全解決。
brief.outcomeZh: 能判斷現有資料是否足以支持最終定論，並建議下一步核實。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 12, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: One short article should not be the last word on the subject.

listening.en: A short article blamed the town’s old bridge for every traffic delay, but engineers had not finished their study. The article was not the last word on the matter.
listening.zh: 一篇短文把鎮上所有交通延誤都歸咎於舊橋，但工程師仍未完成研究。那篇文章並非此事的最後定論。
listening.promptZh: 為何文章不能被當成最後定論？

options.en: The engineers were still gathering evidence.
options.zh: 工程師仍在搜集證據。

options.en: The article was the official final engineering report.
options.zh: 那篇文章就是正式的最終工程報告。

options.en: Everyone had already agreed on the cause.
options.zh: 所有人早已同意成因。

options.en: The unfinished study concerns costs rather than traffic delays.
options.zh: 尚未完成的研究只涉及費用，不涉及交通延誤。

listening.explanationZh: 研究未完成，單一短文不足以作為交通延誤的最終解釋。

reply.promptEn: Can one visitor review settle whether the new community centre works well for everyone?
reply.promptZh: （一篇訪客評論能否判定新社區中心是否適合所有人？）

options.en: We should hear from more kinds of visitors.
options.zh: 我們應聽取更多不同訪客的意見。

options.en: We need to see how the centre works at different times.
options.zh: 我們需要看看中心在不同時間如何運作。

options.en: One review should not be the last word on the centre.
options.zh: 一篇評論不應成為對這間中心的最後定論。

options.en: It would help to ask staff about common problems too.
options.zh: 也可以向職員了解常見問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理主張繼續查證；金句明確指出單一評論不能成為最終定論。

scene.promptZh: 學生只讀了一篇談古城歷史的短文，老師提醒她新發現的文物可能改變解釋。哪句最貼切？

options.en: That one article may not be the last word on the city’s history.
options.zh: 那篇文章未必是古城歷史的最後定論。

options.en: The newly found object has already proved every claim in the article false.
options.zh: 新文物已證明文章中的每項說法都錯。

options.en: The article is useful background, so no further source needs to be checked.
options.zh: 文章可作背景資料，所以不用再核對其他來源。

scene.explanationZh: 新文物可能帶來新解釋，一篇短文未必足以定論。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種情況最有根據把一份文件視為某個狹窄問題的 the last word on？

options.en: A committee fully reviews the evidence and signs its final decision on that procedure.
options.zh: 委員會完整審核證據後，就該程序問題簽署最終決定。

options.en: A single unverified rumour circulates before the inquiry starts.
options.zh: 調查開始前流傳一則未核實的傳聞。

options.en: An early study says further measurements are still needed.
options.zh: 一項初步研究指出仍須進一步量度。

contrast.explanationZh: 經完整審核的正式最終決定，才較有根據被視為該狹窄程序問題的定論。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「網上第一篇文章說這條河已沒有魚，不用再查了。」你知道下週會公布新生態調查。哪個回應最合理？

options.en: That article is not the last word on the river; let us read the new survey before deciding.
options.zh: 那篇文章不是這條河的最後定論；作決定前先看看新調查吧。

options.en: The first article settles the whole question, so the new survey cannot add anything useful.
options.zh: 第一篇文章已解決整個問題，新調查不可能提供有用資料。

options.en: The new survey will definitely prove the first article false, even before it is published.
options.zh: 新調查還未公布，也肯定會證明第一篇文章錯誤。

dialogue.explanationZh: 新調查尚未公布，不能預先斷定結果；也不能把第一篇文章當成最終定論。

speaking.en: The first review was not the last word on the exhibition because many visitors had not yet seen it.
speaking.zh: 首篇評論不是展覽的最後定論，因為很多訪客還未看過展覽。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明為何首篇評論不能作定論。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：博物館舊指南說一件雕塑出自某位藝術家，但最近發現一封當時的信件，研究人員正在重新核對資料。用一至兩句英文解釋為何舊指南未必能作最後定論。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出新信件與仍在進行的核對，說明舊指南不一定是最終結論。

examples.en: The old guide may not be the last word on the sculpture’s origin because researchers are examining a newly found letter.
examples.zh: 研究人員正在查閱一封新發現的信，因此舊指南未必是雕塑來源的最後定論。

examples.en: Until the letter is checked, we should not treat the museum guide as the last word on who made the sculpture.
examples.zh: 在信件獲核實前，我們不應把博物館指南當成雕塑作者的最後定論。

takeaways.en: An early forecast is rarely the last word on next week’s weather.
takeaways.zh: 初步預報很少是下週天氣的最後定論。

takeaways.en: The panel’s signed report became the last word on the contest result.
takeaways.zh: 評審小組簽署的報告成為比賽結果的最終定論。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.
Provisional draft pending editorial and source-sense review; no release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Treat an issue, inquiry or chapter of work as finished.
brief.meaningZh: 把某個問題、調查或階段視為已經結束，不再繼續追查或討論。
brief.grammar: close the book on an investigation; not close the book yet.
brief.register: Common figurative phrase; often followed by on plus the matter.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是字面合上書；是否適宜結案要看證據是否充分。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要因出現第一條線索就貿然停止調查，也不要在已充分解決時無限拖延。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明何時仍須跟進，何時可以合理地結束一件事。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 12, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The first report should not close the book on the investigation.

listening.en: The first inventory check found one missing parcel, but several deliveries were still unexamined. The manager refused to close the book on the case yet.
listening.zh: 首次庫存核對發現一件包裹遺失，但還有幾批送貨未檢查。經理拒絕就此結案。
listening.promptZh: 經理為何沒有就此結案？

options.en: There was still relevant evidence to check.
options.zh: 仍有相關資料需要核對。

options.en: Every delivery had already been fully checked.
options.zh: 所有送貨都已徹底核對。

options.en: The manager put the case aside without reviewing the unchecked deliveries.
options.zh: 經理沒核對未檢查的送貨便把案件擱下。

options.en: The missing parcel had already been found.
options.zh: 遺失的包裹已經找到。

listening.explanationZh: 仍有未檢查的送貨，現時就結束調查太早。

reply.promptEn: Should we stop reviewing the playground drainage problem after one dry afternoon?
reply.promptZh: （只有一個乾爽下午，我們便應停止檢查遊樂場排水問題嗎？）

options.en: We should look at what happens after rain.
options.zh: 我們應看看下雨後的情況。

options.en: It would help to ask the caretakers about earlier flooding.
options.zh: 向管理員了解之前有沒有積水會有幫助。

options.en: We should not close the book on it until we check a wet day.
options.zh: 未檢查下雨天的情況前，我們不應就此結案。

options.en: One dry afternoon does not answer the drainage question.
options.zh: 一個乾爽下午不足以回答排水問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出證據尚不足；金句用 close the book 表示不宜過早停止跟進。

scene.promptZh: 圖書館遺失一本珍本書。保安只看了入口錄影，館長仍要求核對借閱紀錄與其他鏡頭。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The director is not ready to close the book on the inquiry.
options.zh: 館長還未準備就調查結案。

options.en: The director has finished checking every possible record.
options.zh: 館長已查完所有可能的紀錄。

options.en: The director chose to finish the inquiry after viewing only the entrance camera.
options.zh: 館長只看了入口鏡頭便決定結束調查。

scene.explanationZh: 還要核對借閱與錄影資料，說明調查未完。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「把事情視作已完結」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 close the book？

options.en: A review panel finishes checking every application and formally signs its final decision.
options.zh: 審核小組核對所有申請後，正式簽署最終決定。

options.en: An inquiry has just begun, with several key witnesses still to interview.
options.zh: 調查剛開始，仍有多名關鍵證人未訪談。

options.en: A repaired machine passes all agreed tests and the service ticket is completed.
options.zh: 修好的機器通過所有約定測試，維修單亦已完成。

contrast.explanationZh: 關鍵證人仍未訪談，現在把調查視為完結並不合適。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我們發現一次記帳錯誤，可以馬上說財務調查完成了嗎？」你知道還有上月單據未核對。哪個回應最恰當？

options.en: Let us not close the book on the investigation until we check last month’s receipts.
options.zh: 核對上月單據前，我們不要就財務調查結案。

options.en: The one error probably explains everything, so we can finish the review now.
options.zh: 一項錯誤大概已解釋一切，我們現在可以結束審查。

options.en: We can publish the first finding as though the remaining receipts have already been checked.
options.zh: 我們可以把初步發現當作已核對餘下單據的結果公布。

dialogue.explanationZh: 上月單據仍未核對，不能因一個發現就結束調查，亦不能把初步結果當成全面結論。

speaking.en: The team did not close the book on the complaint until they had spoken to everyone involved.
speaking.zh: 團隊與所有相關人士交談後，才就那宗投訴結案。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明團隊何時才結束跟進。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區游泳池的水質檢查第一次達標，但還有兩次約定測試尚未完成。負責人建議立即宣布問題已完全解決。用一至兩句英文提出更審慎的做法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出仍有兩次測試，現在不宜視問題為已完結；說明完成核對後再作決定。

examples.en: We should not close the book on the water-quality issue after one test; two checks still remain.
examples.zh: 只完成一次測試，我們不應就水質問題結案；還有兩次檢查未完成。

examples.en: Let us finish the two remaining tests before we close the book on this problem and announce the result.
examples.zh: 我們完成餘下兩次測試後，再把問題視為解決並公布結果吧。

takeaways.en: The committee can close the book on the request after the final documents arrive.
takeaways.zh: 收到最後文件後，委員會可以結束處理這項申請。

takeaways.en: A promising first clue should not close the book on a wider inquiry.
takeaways.zh: 有希望的第一條線索，不應讓更廣泛的調查就此結束。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.
Provisional draft pending editorial and source-sense review; no release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Help explain something that was previously unclear.
brief.meaningZh: 提供資料或角度，使原先不清楚的問題更易理解。
brief.grammar: shed light on a problem; sheds light on why something happened.
brief.register: Neutral useful phrase in reports, discussion and explanation.
brief.boundaryZh: 是幫助理解，不一定提供完整答案或最終證明；不是字面照明。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把無關資料說成能解釋問題，也不要因一條線索就宣稱所有疑問已解決。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出哪項新資料如何幫助釐清一個具體問題。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 13, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The interviews shed light on why customers left.

listening.en: The town knew fewer people were using the evening bus but not why. Interviews shed light on the problem: many residents felt unsafe at the poorly lit stop.
listening.zh: 鎮上知道晚上乘巴士的人少了，卻不知道原因。訪談幫助釐清問題：很多居民覺得燈光不足的車站不安全。

options.en: They offered a possible explanation for falling bus use.
options.zh: 它們為巴士乘客減少提供了可能解釋。

options.en: They proved that nobody had used the evening bus.
options.zh: 它們證明沒有人乘過晚間巴士。

options.en: The interviews showed the bus stop was already brightly lit.
options.zh: 訪談顯示巴士站本來就燈光充足。

options.en: They suggested that the evening route had become slower than before.
options.zh: 它們顯示晚間路線比以往慢了。

listening.explanationZh: 訪談揭示乘客對車站安全的擔心，為原本不明的乘客減少提供可能原因。

reply.promptEn: What clues help explain why the bakery sold fewer loaves after changing its opening hours?
reply.promptZh: （麵包店改了營業時間後，哪些線索有助解釋麵包銷量下降？）

options.en: Some customers said the new closing time was before they finished work.
options.zh: 有些顧客說，新的關門時間早於他們下班時間。

options.en: The sales log shows the largest drop in the hour the shop now closes early.
options.zh: 銷售紀錄顯示，跌幅最大的是店舖現在提早關門的那個時段。

options.en: Customer comments shed light on the drop: regulars can no longer reach the shop before closing.
options.zh: 顧客意見有助解釋銷量下降：熟客現在趕不及在關門前到店。

options.en: Staff noticed fewer after-work visitors once the closing time changed.
options.zh: 員工留意到關門時間改變後，下班後來訪的顧客少了。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都提供營業時間改變後的具體線索；金句用 shed light on 說明顧客意見如何幫助解釋銷量下降。

scene.promptZh: 校園花圃的幼苗突然枯萎。園藝小組查看澆水紀錄，發現噴水器有三天沒有運作。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The watering record sheds light on why the seedlings wilted.
options.zh: 澆水紀錄幫助解釋幼苗為何枯萎。

options.en: The record confirms that the sprinkler worked every day.
options.zh: 紀錄證實噴水器每天都有運作。

options.en: The record says only when the group planted the seedlings, not when they were watered.
options.zh: 紀錄只寫下幼苗種植日期，沒有記下澆水時間。

scene.explanationZh: 紀錄顯示噴水器停了三天，為枯萎提供了可能解釋；另外兩句與紀錄內容不符。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「提供有關線索、幫助理解」的意思，哪個情況最不適合說 shed light on？

options.en: Interview notes reveal why pupils avoid the old stairway.
options.zh: 訪談筆記揭示學生為何避開舊樓梯。

options.en: A random photo of an unrelated building is added to a report about missing library books.
options.zh: 一張無關建築的隨意照片，被放入調查圖書館失書的報告。

options.en: A timed log shows when a machine first began to fail.
options.zh: 有時間記錄的日誌顯示機器最初何時開始故障。

contrast.explanationZh: 無關照片不能幫助理解失書問題；另外兩項提供直接相關資料。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說：「我們知道公園晚上很少人去，但不知道原因。」你已收集訪客意見，顯示入口照明不足。哪個回應最準確？

options.en: The visitor comments shed light on why the park is quiet at night, though we should still check other factors.
options.zh: 訪客意見幫助解釋公園晚上冷清的原因，但我們仍應查看其他因素。

options.en: The comments prove that lighting is the only possible cause.
options.zh: 意見證明照明是唯一可能的原因。

options.en: The comments are unrelated to why visitors avoid the entrance.
options.zh: 訪客意見與他們為何避開入口完全無關。

dialogue.explanationZh: 訪客意見提供合理線索，但不保證已排除所有其他原因。

speaking.en: The dispatch log shows parcels waited two extra hours at the depot; that sheds light on why they arrived late.
speaking.zh: 派件紀錄顯示包裹在分發中心多等了兩小時；這有助解釋它們為何遲到。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明派件紀錄揭示延誤發生在哪個環節。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校發現圖書館書籍經常遲還，卻不知道原因。問卷顯示，不少學生放學後趕不上還書櫃台的關門時間。用一至兩句英文說明問卷如何幫助理解問題。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出問卷提供具體線索，有助理解遲還原因；不要聲稱已找出所有原因。

examples.en: The survey sheds light on late returns by showing that many pupils miss the desk before it closes.
examples.zh: 問卷顯示很多學生趕不上還書櫃台關門時間，幫助理解遲還問題。

examples.en: Students’ comments shed light on the problem: the return desk closes before some pupils can reach it.
examples.zh: 學生意見幫助解釋問題：部分學生到達前，還書櫃台已經關門。

takeaways.en: The diary shed light on how the old harbour was used.
takeaways.zh: 那本日記幫助我們了解舊港口以往如何使用。

takeaways.en: One clue may shed light on the question without settling it completely.
takeaways.zh: 一條線索或許能幫助理解問題，卻未必能完全解決。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.
Provisional draft pending editorial and source-sense review; no release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Exaggerate facts beyond what the evidence supports to make a story or claim sound better.
brief.meaningZh: 為使說法更吸引而誇大真實情況，超出證據支持的程度。
brief.grammar: stretch the truth about a result; stretched the truth in an advert.
brief.register: Conversational idiom for exaggeration; overlaps with bend the truth, with emphasis here on enlarging a claim.
brief.boundaryZh: 與 bend the truth 都可指誤導；bend the truth 可包括挑選或扭曲細節，本課的 stretch the truth 特別指把真實成果誇大至超出證據支持的規模。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把明確標示的估計值當成誇大，也不要因喜歡故事就忽視可核實的事實。
brief.outcomeZh: 能辨認過度誇大的說法，並提出保留真實成果的準確改寫。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 13, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The advertisement seemed to stretch the truth about the result.

listening.en: The club won three of its five debates, but the newsletter said it had won every debate. The writer stretched the truth to make the season sound perfect.
listening.zh: 辯論學會在五場比賽中贏了三場，但通訊寫成每場都贏。作者誇大事實，令整個賽季聽起來完美。
listening.promptZh: 通訊的說法有甚麼問題？

options.en: It exaggerated a real success into a perfect record.
options.zh: 它把真實的勝利誇大成全勝紀錄。

options.en: It stated the three wins out of five accurately.
options.zh: 它準確寫出五場中勝了三場。

options.en: It warned readers that its claim was only an estimate.
options.zh: 它提醒讀者，說法只是估算。

options.en: It said the club had entered no debates at all.
options.zh: 它說學會完全沒有參加辯論。

listening.explanationZh: 三勝五場是事實，但寫成全勝，將成果誇大至超出紀錄。

reply.promptEn: How should we present our school garden’s first harvest in the newsletter?
reply.promptZh: （校園花園第一次收成，通訊應怎樣呈現？）

options.en: We should count what was actually harvested.
options.zh: 我們應計算實際收成。

options.en: We can say it produced twenty baskets if the records confirm that number.
options.zh: 若紀錄證實有二十籃，我們可以照實寫。

options.en: We must not stretch the truth by calling twenty baskets hundreds.
options.zh: 我們不可把二十籃說成數百籃，藉此誇大事實。

options.en: We can include a photo of the measured harvest.
options.zh: 我們可以附上已量度收成的照片。

reply.explanationZh: 四個做法都支持準確呈報；金句點出不能把真實數量誇大許多。

scene.promptZh: 社區花園第一次收成只有一籃番茄，通訊卻宣稱這批收成足以供應整個社區一星期。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The newsletter stretches the truth about what this harvest can provide.
options.zh: 通訊誇大了這批收成能供應的數量。

options.en: The newsletter accurately reports that the first harvest filled one basket.
options.zh: 通訊如實報告第一次收成只有一籃。

options.en: The newsletter says the garden may produce more next season.
options.zh: 通訊說花園下季可能有更多收成。

scene.explanationZh: 只有一籃番茄，卻說足以供應整個社區一星期，是把真實成果誇大至超出證據支持的規模。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「把事實說得過大」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 stretch the truth？

options.en: A brochure claims a small room seats a thousand, though it holds only fifty.
options.zh: 小房間只容納五十人，小冊子卻聲稱有一千個座位。

options.en: A survey report says “roughly one hundred” for a verified count of ninety-eight.
options.zh: 核實人數為九十八，調查報告清楚寫成「約一百」。

options.en: A player says she won every match when she won only two of six.
options.zh: 球員六場只贏兩場，卻說自己全勝。

contrast.explanationZh: 九十八寫成清楚標示的約一百，是合理約數，沒有把成果誇大。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們只修好十輛單車，海報可以寫一百輛，較吸引吧？」哪個回應最合適？

options.en: That would stretch the truth. Let us celebrate the ten repairs we actually completed.
options.zh: 那會誇大事實。我們如實慶祝完成的十輛維修吧。

options.en: We could round ten up to one hundred without noting how we calculated it.
options.zh: 我們可以把十輛算成一百輛，不用說明如何計算。

options.en: Put one hundred in the headline and the real count in small print.
options.zh: 標題寫一百輛，真實數目則用細字印出。

dialogue.explanationZh: 把十輛說成一百輛，即使在別處以細字補上真數字，仍會誤導讀者。

speaking.en: The speaker stretched the truth when he called a modest increase a tenfold rise.
speaking.zh: 增幅其實不大，講者卻稱它上升十倍，誇大了事實。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明講者如何誇大增幅。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生會在清潔日收集了三十袋垃圾。有同學想在校報寫成「數百袋」，讓活動看起來更成功。用一至兩句英文指出問題並建議準確寫法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出把三十袋寫成數百袋是誇大，應如實呈報並肯定實際成果。

examples.en: Calling thirty bags “hundreds” would stretch the truth. We should report the real total and thank the volunteers.
examples.zh: 把三十袋說成「數百袋」會誇大事實。我們應報告真實總數並感謝義工。

examples.en: We need not stretch the truth about the clean-up: the school paper should say we collected thirty bags, a real result worth celebrating.
examples.zh: 我們不用誇大清潔活動的成果：校報應寫明我們收集了三十袋垃圾，這是真實而值得肯定的成果。

takeaways.en: The poster stretched the truth about how many trees had been planted.
takeaways.zh: 海報誇大了種植樹木的數量。

takeaways.en: We can be proud of the result without stretching the truth.
takeaways.zh: 我們可以為成果自豪，毋須誇大事實。

brief.meaningEn: Become available or happen, especially of an opportunity.
brief.meaningZh: 指機會、邀請或合適時機出現，可供人把握。
brief.grammar: an opportunity comes along; a chance like this may not come along soon.
brief.register: Everyday conversational phrase; the subject is usually a chance or opportunity in this sense.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課指機會出現，不是某人沿路走來或陪同出行。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要假設機會一定會再來，也不要把已經存在但無法參與的事硬說成出現可把握的機會。
brief.outcomeZh: 能辨認新出現的機會並說明合理的下一步。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 13, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A chance like this may not come along soon.

listening.en: A free place opened in the weekend photography class. When an opportunity like that comes along, Mei likes to ask about the schedule before deciding.
listening.zh: 週末攝影班空出一個免費名額。有這樣的機會出現時，美會先詢問時間表再決定。
listening.promptZh: 這裏的 comes along 指甚麼？

options.en: A useful opportunity becomes available.
options.zh: 一個有用的機會出現。

options.en: Mei walks along the road to class.
options.zh: 美沿着道路步行去上課。

options.en: Mei has already registered without asking about the schedule.
options.zh: 美尚未問時間表，就已經報名。

options.en: The free place had already been taken when Mei heard about it.
options.zh: 美得知消息時，免費名額已被人取走。

listening.explanationZh: 免費名額新近空出，表示機會出現；不能推斷美已報名或名額已額滿。

reply.promptEn: What would you do if a free place in the local art workshop became available?
reply.promptZh: （如果本地美術工作坊有免費名額，你會怎樣做？）

options.en: I would check whether its time suits me.
options.zh: 我會看看時間是否適合。

options.en: I would ask what materials I need to bring.
options.zh: 我會問要帶甚麼材料。

options.en: If a chance like that comes along, I would consider joining.
options.zh: 若有這種機會出現，我會考慮參加。

options.en: I would speak to the organiser before signing up.
options.zh: 報名前，我會先問問主辦者。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都是面對新名額時可做的合理回應；金句用 comes along 指機會出現。

scene.promptZh: 一間電台突然開放一個學生錄音名額，學校原本沒有預計會有這種機會。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A rare opportunity has come along for the students.
options.zh: 學生碰上一個難得的機會。

options.en: The recording slot had already been filled before the students heard about it.
options.zh: 學生得知消息前，錄音名額已有人填補。

options.en: The station might offer a slot later, but no place is available now.
options.zh: 電台日後可能提供名額，但目前沒有空缺。

scene.explanationZh: 臨時開放錄音名額，表示原本沒有的機會現在可把握。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「機會出現」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 come along？

options.en: A scholarship place becomes available after a student withdraws.
options.zh: 一名學生退出後，獎學金名額空出。

options.en: A guide walks along the path beside a group of visitors.
options.zh: 導遊沿着小路陪訪客步行。

options.en: An invitation to join a new project arrives unexpectedly.
options.zh: 突然收到參與新項目的邀請。

contrast.explanationZh: 導遊沿路同行是 come along 的移動意思，不是本課的機會出現。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「社區廣播站剛有一個新節目助理名額，我一直想學錄音。」哪個回應最貼切？

options.en: When a chance like this comes along, check the duties and apply if they suit you.
options.zh: 有這樣的機會出現時，先看看職責；適合的話便申請。

options.en: Apply straight away and read the duties only if they offer you the place.
options.zh: 先立即申請；如果獲取錄，才細看工作職責。

options.en: It sounds interesting, but leave this opening aside and wait for another one before checking the duties.
options.zh: 聽起來很有趣，但先放過這次名額，等下次有空缺才細看職責。

dialogue.explanationZh: 名額與朋友興趣相關，但仍應先看清職責再決定是否申請。

speaking.en: A chance to display her sketches came along when the community hall planned a local art show.
speaking.zh: 社區會堂籌辦本地藝術展時，她得到展示素描的機會。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明甚麼新機會出現了。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一位學生喜歡天文學。社區中心突然增加一場免費夜空觀察活動，還有幾個名額。她要先核對時間和交通。用一至兩句英文描述這個機會和合理的下一步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明新名額讓機會出現，同時提到核對時間或交通；不要假設一定能參加。

examples.en: A chance to join the free stargazing evening has come along, so she should check the time and bus route before registering.
examples.zh: 參加免費觀星晚會的機會出現了，所以她報名前應先核對時間和巴士路線。

examples.en: When an opportunity like this comes along, she can ask about the journey and decide whether she can attend.
examples.zh: 有這種機會出現時，她可先問清交通，再決定能否出席。

takeaways.en: A useful volunteer opportunity came along just before the holidays.
takeaways.zh: 假期前，剛好有一個有用的義工機會出現。

takeaways.en: If another chance comes along, I will read the details before applying.
takeaways.zh: 若再有機會出現，我會先看詳情再申請。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.

brief.meaningEn: Maintain an audience’s strong interest so they want to continue.
brief.meaningZh: 持續吸引讀者、聽眾或觀眾，讓他們想追下去。
brief.grammar: keep them hooked until the end; kept them hooked throughout.
brief.register: Informal figurative phrase for storytelling and engaging content.
brief.boundaryZh: them 必須有清楚的指代對象；重點是興趣持續，不只是開頭一秒被吸引。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 hooked 理解成真的用鉤子鉤住，也不要把突兀的懸念當成唯一方法。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出具體敘事安排如何讓一群人持續關注。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 13, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The mystery should keep them hooked until the final chapter.

listening.en: The podcast asked a new question at the end of each episode and answered it in the next. That pattern kept listeners curious and helped keep them hooked through the whole series.
listening.zh: 播客每集結尾提出一個新問題，下一集才解答。這種安排令聽眾保持好奇，整個系列都想繼續聽。
listening.promptZh: 播客如何令聽眾持續有興趣？

options.en: It gave them a reason to hear the next episode.
options.zh: 它讓聽眾有理由繼續聽下一集。

options.en: Each episode repeats the same facts without developing the question.
options.zh: 每集只重複同樣的事實，沒有推進問題。

options.en: Each episode switches to a new, unrelated topic and drops the earlier mystery.
options.zh: 每集都轉到互不相關的新主題，放棄之前的謎團。

options.en: Only the first episode has an intriguing opening; the later ones add nothing new.
options.zh: 只有第一集有吸引人的開頭，往後各集都沒有新內容。

listening.explanationZh: 每集留下問題、下集再解答，能讓聽眾持續好奇。

reply.promptEn: How could the children’s audio story hold listeners’ attention from one episode to the next?
reply.promptZh: （兒童聲音故事怎樣能讓聽眾從一集到下一集仍有興趣？）

options.en: It could develop the characters a little in every episode.
options.zh: 它可以在每集逐步發展角色。

options.en: It could give the children a puzzle to follow.
options.zh: 它可以讓孩子追看一個謎題。

options.en: A clear ongoing mystery could keep them hooked.
options.zh: 清楚而持續的謎團可以讓他們一直聽得入迷。

options.en: It could answer one question and raise another.
options.zh: 它可以解答一個問題，再提出另一個。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能合理維持兒童聽眾興趣；金句用 keep them hooked 指持續吸引。

scene.promptZh: 一部網上科學短片系列，每集用簡單實驗回答上集留下的問題，觀眾常會期待下一集。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The continuing questions keep them hooked.
options.zh: 接連出現的問題令他們一直看得入迷。

options.en: Viewers enjoy the first clip but see no reason to watch the next one.
options.zh: 觀眾喜歡第一段影片，卻沒有理由接着看下一段。

options.en: A strong first clip will keep viewers hooked even if later episodes stop developing the questions.
options.zh: 即使後續影片不再發展問題，只靠精彩的第一集仍能讓觀眾一直追看。

scene.explanationZh: 上一集留下問題、下一集回答，令觀眾持續期待。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「長時間維持受眾興趣」的意思，哪個情況最不適合說 keep them hooked？

options.en: A serial story lets readers follow a changing character over several chapters.
options.zh: 連載故事讓讀者跨越多章追隨角色變化。

options.en: A video has a striking opening image, but viewers quickly leave because nothing follows.
options.zh: 影片開場畫面很搶眼，但之後沒有內容，觀眾很快離開。

options.en: A tour reveals new clues at each stop, encouraging visitors to finish.
options.zh: 導賞在每一站揭示新線索，鼓勵訪客走完全程。

contrast.explanationZh: 只在開頭吸睛、觀眾隨即離開，不是持續維持興趣。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我做的歷史短片開頭有人看，但大家很快就關掉。」你知道他有一段後來才揭示的日記內容。哪個建議最實際？

options.en: Give viewers a question about the diary early on; the later answer may keep them hooked.
options.zh: 開頭先提出一個與日記有關的問題，稍後揭曉答案，或可令觀眾一直看下去。

options.en: Reveal the diary answer in the first few seconds, then repeat it without new detail.
options.zh: 在開頭幾秒就揭曉日記答案，之後只重複同一內容。

options.en: Present several unrelated facts without returning to the diary question.
options.zh: 列出幾項互不相關的事實，卻不再回應日記的問題。

dialogue.explanationZh: 開頭提出與日記有關的問題，後段給出答案，為觀眾提供持續觀看的理由。

speaking.en: Readers followed the mystery as it introduced a new clue in every chapter, and that kept them hooked until the ending.
speaking.zh: 讀者追看這部懸疑小說，因為它每章加入新線索，令他們一直看到結局。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明甚麼令讀者一直追看。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你的自然觀察小組每週給同學發一則簡短電子通訊。你想讓同學願意連續閱讀四週，而不是只看第一期。你們能在每期加入一個小謎題，下一期再揭曉。用一至兩句英文提出做法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 明確指出同學是 them，並說明每期謎題及後續答案如何維持興趣。

examples.en: We could give classmates a new nature puzzle each week and reveal the answer later to keep them hooked.
examples.zh: 我們可以每週給同學一個新的自然謎題，稍後才揭曉答案，讓他們一直讀得入迷。

examples.en: Our readers may stay curious if each newsletter ends with a question; the next issue can answer it and keep them hooked.
examples.zh: 若每期通訊都以問題作結，讀者或會保持好奇；下一期解答問題，便能讓他們繼續追看。

takeaways.en: The readers followed every clue; the author kept them hooked until the end.
takeaways.zh: 讀者追看每條線索；作者讓他們一直看到結局。

takeaways.en: For viewers, a strong opening matters, but the middle must also keep them hooked.
takeaways.zh: 對觀眾而言，有力的開頭固然重要，中段也必須持續吸引他們。
